<!--
Title: imperative for features ("Keep Android downloads running in the background"),
"Bug: <what was broken>" for bug fixes.

Write each section as short bullets with a bold label, not paragraphs.
Delete any section that doesn't apply, and these comments.
-->

## Why this PR <does what it does>

- **Problem:** what the user sees, and on which platform.
- **Cause:** for bugs, what actually goes wrong. Point to the evidence (log line, code path).
- **Fix:** the change in one or two lines.
- **Why this approach:** what makes it the right place or tool.
- **What it is:** size, files or modules, the API it adds, platforms it affects.

## Alternatives considered

- **<Option>:** why it wasn't chosen. Include the strongest counter-option, not only easy ones.

## Costs

- **<Cost>:** release steps (store declarations, config), limits, follow-on changes, maintenance.
  Say when a claim comes from documentation rather than testing.

## Also in this PR

- **<Change>:** smaller changes that ride along.

## Testing

- Commands run and the test count (`tsc`, `pnpm test`, lint, format).
- **<Device> (<OS version>), <build type>:** what was checked and what happened.
- **Not yet tested:** anything a reviewer might assume was checked.
